probability_semantics: Native Human/AI/AI-edited/Humanized classes; not word shares or verified writing history.
cautions: In the saved 36-document English pilot, high-score false positives occurred on human writing. Do not treat a near-1 score as established authorship.
English four-class outputs are uncalibrated experimental auxiliary scores.

windows.quote:
Hi Morgan,

Thank you for your patience while I reviewed the duplicate charge on order R-214. I confirmed that the second payment was taken on 18 September and submitted a refund request for £36 this morning. The payment team has not approved it yet, and the request covers only the duplicate £36 payment. I cannot cancel the first payment because the order has already shipped.

I understand why seeing two charges would be frustrating, and I am sorry for the extra work this has caused you. There is no need for you to submit another form while the request is pending. If the team approves it, the money should reach the original card within five working days, though that is an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date.

I will email you by 3 p.m. on Friday even if I am still waiting for a decision. If you do not receive that update, please reply to this email with the order number.

Best,
Alex

occlusion.interpretation: Sensitivity to deleting a paragraph. Positive delta means removal lowered the score; length/context changes confound this. This is not causal authorship evidence or a sentence probability.
